directive.name: github
directive.description: Integrate with GitHub Issues and PRs via MCP. Issues provide human visibility. PRs enable team review workflow. State lives in GitHub - commands are stateless and resumable.

context.principle: Every task syncs to a GitHub Issue. Title from task title, body is raw XML.
PRs replace local merges. Check PR approval state before merging.
Commands read GitHub state each run. User can close terminal and resume anytime.
PR body includes "Closes #N" to auto-close issue when PR merges.
Use GitHub MCP tools: mcp__GitHub__issue_write, mcp__GitHub__issue_read, mcp__GitHub__create_pull_request, mcp__GitHub__pull_request_read, mcp__GitHub__merge_pull_request.

override.reason: GitHub PR workflow replaces local git merge

process.rule:
AFTER creating task.xml, sync to GitHub:
IF $ARGUMENTS was a GitHub issue number (#N or just N): 1. Fetch issue via mcp__GitHub__issue_read (method: "get") 2. Add github-issue="#N" and github-url to task element 3. Output: "Linked to GitHub Issue #N"
ELSE (normal title): 1. Get owner/repo from: git remote get-url origin 2. Create issue via mcp__GitHub__issue_write: - method: "create" - title: task title - body: raw task.xml in ```xml code fence 3. Add github-issue="#N" and github-url to task element 4. Output: "Created GitHub Issue #N"

STATE CHECK: Read task.xml, check for github-pr attribute.
No github-pr → Go to M-G2 (create PR) Has github-pr → Go to M-G3 (check status)

CHECK PR STATUS via mcp__GitHub__pull_request_read (method: "get"):
- state="merged" → Go to M-G4 - state="closed" → Prompt: "PR closed. Create new?" - reviewDecision="CHANGES_REQUESTED" → Prompt with PR link, EXIT - reviewDecision="APPROVED" → Go to M-G5 - reviewDecision=null AND mergeable_state="clean" → Go to M-G5 (no review required) - else → Prompt: "Awaiting review or checks", EXIT

PR ALREADY MERGED (cleanup): 1. git checkout main && git pull (get merged changes FIRST) 2. git branch -D task/{taskId} (delete orphaned task branch) 3. Update task: status="done", add completed date 4. Commit on main: "docs({taskId}): done - {title}" 5. git push 6. Output: "PR was already merged! Task complete." 7. EXIT

MERGE APPROVED PR: 1. Prompt: "PR approved. Ready to merge? [Merge now] [Wait]" 2. If merge: mcp__GitHub__merge_pull_request (merge_method: "rebase") 3. git checkout main && git pull (get merged changes FIRST) 4. git branch -D task/{taskId} (delete orphaned task branch) 5. Update task: status="done", add completed date 6. Commit on main: "docs({taskId}): done - {title}" 7. git push 8. Output: "Merged! Task complete." 9. EXIT

check.item: GitHub MCP server is connected (mcp__GitHub__ tools available)
Repository has remote origin (git remote -v shows origin)

example.explanation: Task has github-issue and github-url attributes.

example.code: # WRONG when GitHub directive is active: git checkout main git merge task/021 --no-ff
example.explanation: Never perform local merge. Use PR workflow instead.
